verdict.rationale: Fathom's own docs show it captures and records meetings, with unlimited recordings and transcriptions. Users can choose bot capture or bot-free capture (in beta), and recordings can be downloaded via the API. The evidence never names Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams, and nothing independent corroborates reliability, so only the general capture half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Zoom, Google Meet and Teams support, evidence of capture reliability, controls for choosing which meetings get recorded, a non-beta bot-free mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it
